name: BCL6 transcription repressor

function.text: BCL6 encodes a transcriptional repressor important for germinal-center B-cell development and regulation of differentiation and DNA-damage-response programs.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; DLBCL / high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
